name: Does the type of property (e.g., condo vs. single-family home) affect the pricing strategy?

mainEntity.name: Does the type of property (e.g., condo vs. single-family home) affect the pricing strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the type of property significantly impacts the pricing strategy. Condos often have comparable units within the same building or complex, making it easier to pinpoint a tight price range based on recent sales and amenities. Single-family homes, especially those with unique lots or custom features, require a broader analysis of neighborhood sales and property specifics. For example, a luxury condo in Aventura might be priced differently than a single-family home in Pinecrest due to different market drivers and buyer expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property type affects pricing; condos use building comparables, while single-family homes require broader neighborhood and specific feature analysis.
